notes.title: Update Released!
notes.content:
We apologize it took so long to release this update.

Loading has been improved substantially as well as the controls.

If you have any issues, please report them by sending an email to:
mail@tasappsystems.com 

Thank you

notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.content:
This update optimizes loading.
It still takes about 2 minutes as we're loading the entire game in one shot.
We also have a new vegetation engine which takes a bit longer to load.

notes.title: Major Update Released
notes.content:
The new update is out.

- Major updates to the underwater world.  Including new marine life, sunken artifacts, and more

- Bug fixes to colliders

- Bug fixes to the story line 

- Bug fixes for the quests.

Thank you for your support, it allows us to continue to update the game as work towards the final release.

notes.title: Patch Released!
notes.content:
We just released the update which has a large number of fixes.

- The character will no longer get stuck
- The quests update correctly
- The controls for the submarine have been updated and improved

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Patch Coming Today!
notes.content:
We apologize for a few of the serious bugs that made it into the release yesterday.

A patch and game update will be available today by 3pm Pacific time.

Thank you

notes.title: Patch Coming Tomorrow!
notes.content:
We're aware of a few major bugs and a patch is coming tomorrow.

The patch will fix the following issue:

1) The character randomly becoming stuck on stairs and the sidewalk.

2) The text/guide for the second quest

3) Sub controls to submerge and rise for both the controller and the keyboard
